title: Distributional Discontinuity Design
summary: Regression discontinuity and kink designs are typically analyzed through mean effects, even when treatment changes the shape of the entire outcome distribution. To address this, we introduce distributional discontinuity designs, a framework for estimating causal effects for a scalar outcome at the boundary of a discontinuity in treatment assignment. Our estimand is the Wasserstein distance between limiting conditional outcome distributions; a single scale-interpretable measure of distribution shift.
